Read a raw CSV file

read_raw_csv.Rd

Read a CSV file from disk and load it into a data.frame. This function assumes semicolon (;) as the field separator and does not convert character vectors to factors.

Usage

read_raw_csv(file_path)

Arguments

file_path

A character string indicating the path to the CSV file.

Value

A data.frame containing the raw data.

See also

Other Validation functions: deduplicate_rows(), enforce_types(), standardize_colnames(), validate_schema()

Examples

# Create a temporary CSV file for the example
tf <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
writeLines("col1;col2\n1;a\n2;b", tf)

# Use the function
df <- read_raw_csv(tf)
print(df)
#>   col1 col2
#> 1    1    a
#> 2    2    b

# Cleanup
unlink(tf)
